mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_action_request ( action_token, dedupe_key, request_id, action_type, task_id, decision, proposed_comment, status, expires_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{actionToken}, #{dedupeKey}, #{requestId}, #{actionType}, #{taskId}, #{decision}, #{proposedComment}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_action_request WHERE action_token = #{actionToken} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM agent_action_request WHERE action_token = #{actionToken} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM agent_action_request WHERE dedupe_key = #{dedupeKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_action_request SET status = 'EXECUTED', confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, result_summary = #{resultSummary}, executed_at = #{executedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION'
UPDATE agent_action_request SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION'
